meta.first_pass_author: claude (2026-07-10) — statuses are a first-pass assessment against the hazop-ai codebase; review and correct
meta.note: This file is the RTM source of truth (Fable section 9: controlled deliverable). Auto-scanned code citations are merged in by hazop/rtm.py at read time and are not stored here.

requirements.text: Strict data-level separation of AI-generated vs human-validated content; every record carries provenance.
requirements.notes: Provenance enum on findings/rows; telemetry encodes the accepted/edited transitions.

requirements.text: Degraded manual mode: full worksheet functionality without AI if AI services are unavailable.
requirements.notes: No manual worksheet authoring UI exists; the dashboard worksheet is generator-driven.

requirements.text: AI inference deployable on-prem / customer-controlled tenancy; no third-party transmission without explicit config.
requirements.notes: LocalLLM + LocalEvidenceCritic over OpenAI-compatible servers; Anthropic branch is opt-in config. Legal-review step is organizational.

requirements.text: Air-gapped deployment supported.
requirements.notes: Stub/local paths run fully offline and Docker image exists, but no validated air-gapped install procedure.

requirements.text: Versioned APIs on all subsystems; AI Reasoning Engine swappable behind a model-agnostic layer.
requirements.notes: LLMInterface/RetrieverInterface/EvidenceCriticInterface seams make the ARE swappable; no versioned inter-subsystem APIs.

requirements.text: Ingest P&IDs in native CAD (DWG/DGN), intelligent formats (SPPID/AVEVA/DEXPI), and scanned PDF/raster.
requirements.notes: Vector-PDF ingestion done (deterministic geometry); DEXPI export done. DWG/DGN import and raster ingestion absent.

requirements.text: Intelligent P&ID formats: extract topology with >= 99% fidelity to source data model.
requirements.notes: DEXPI/ISO 15926 canonical model exists; no SPPID/AVEVA importers to measure fidelity against.

requirements.text: Raster/scanned P&IDs: symbol recognition + line tracing with per-class precision/recall targets (ISA 5.1).
requirements.notes: Current L1 is deliberately vector-only (no ML/OCR). Raster path = MDL-4 training-data plan; not started.

requirements.text: Ingest supporting documents (datasheets, setpoint lists, C&E, relief datasheets, MSDS/SDS, procedures) and link attributes to topology.
requirements.notes: KB ingests curated SDS/datasheet/standard docs; automatic attribute-to-topology-element linking absent.

requirements.text: Detect and flag cross-document inconsistencies (e.g. PSV set pressure vs vessel MAWP).
All extracted data human-verifiable via side-by-side view with one-click correction.
requirements.notes: L1 overlay sheets in dashboard + standalone validator app (hazop_L1 app.py :8777) with accept/reject; one-click correction flow incomplete.

requirements.text: Directed process graph supporting upstream/downstream tracing, isolation boundaries, flow-path enumeration.
requirements.notes: Direction-confidence-aware tracing; live in the Plant Graph tab.

requirements.text: Propose HAZOP node boundaries from design-intent changes, subject to facilitator approval.
requirements.notes: Type-level design-intent rules propose nodes, ambiguities flagged for facilitator; proposals labeled as proposals.

requirements.text: Integrate >= 1 steady-state simulator (HYSYS target, DWSIM fallback) for deviation screening.
requirements.notes: Screening seam exists; DWSIM adapter is the planned next step.

requirements.text: Simulation-derived screens labeled with case ID, model version, convergence status; unreliable results flagged.
requirements.notes: Blocked on FR-PML-3; labeling pattern already proven on the heuristic path.

requirements.text: Heuristic fallback where no simulation model exists, clearly labeled as estimates.
requirements.notes: Deadhead/compressor heuristics emit ESTIMATE labels with reliable=False.

requirements.text: Full IEC 61882 guideword set per parameter, filtered only for physical applicability; hazards never suppressed.
requirements.notes: Deterministic matrix; check-valve case raised as deviation with safeguard, never hidden.

requirements.text: Ranked candidate causes grounded in topology, KB failure modes (OREDA-type), historical HAZOP RAG, incident precedents.
requirements.notes: Topology + hybrid RAG + historical precedents done; OREDA reliability categories and licensed incident DBs (CSB/IChemE/Marsh) absent.

requirements.text: Consequences propagated through the topology graph, citing the graph path and any simulation screen used.
requirements.notes: Topology propagation primitives + consequence generation exist; explicit graph-path citation inside consequence text is thin; no simulation screens yet.

requirements.text: Safeguards from topology and C&E data; distinguish prevention vs mitigation; flag IPL candidates.
requirements.notes: Topology-derived safeguards (relief path, check valves) done with direction-confidence; C&E ingestion and prevention/mitigation/IPL classification absent.

requirements.text: Every suggestion carries confidence, explicit evidence citations, and NL rationale; no-evidence suggestions labeled unsupported inference.
requirements.notes: Composed confidence (never model self-report), citations survive export, UNSUPPORTED INFERENCE labeling.

requirements.text: No auto-populated risk rankings; severity/likelihood human-only.
requirements.notes: Severity/likelihood left None by construction.

requirements.text: Natural-language facilitator prompts returning structured worksheet-ready entries.
Completeness critic pass at node close-out: matrix coverage, sibling nodes, precedent comparison, gap list.
requirements.notes: Matrix-coverage + no-consequence + low-confidence + unsupported channels done and MDL-13-gated at 100%; sibling/precedent comparison is a future extension.

requirements.text: Hallucination controls: tag validation against topology, schema-constrained generation, refusal over fabrication.
requirements.notes: Stage A hard gate + JSON-schema outputs + refusal handling + Stage B evidence critic.

requirements.text: Live facilitation view with suggestions tray; accept/edit/reject; never auto-inserted into the official worksheet.
requirements.notes: Worksheet view with per-finding accept/edit/reject buttons exists; a true suggestions-tray -> official-worksheet flow does not.

requirements.text: Accept/edit/reject logged with user identity and timestamp (doubles as training/eval signal).
requirements.notes: Append-only JSONL with identity, timestamp, version triplet; UI wired. User identity is a placeholder until auth (FR-AGM-1) exists.

requirements.text: Standard worksheet columns incl. S/L/R per configurable risk matrix, configurable templates.
requirements.notes: Standard columns present; customer-configurable templates and risk-matrix config absent.

requirements.text: Session management: attendance, minutes, parking lot, revisit flags, progress metrics.
Offline/disconnected session capture with later synchronization.
requirements.notes: Telemetry endpoint accepts client-supplied ids/timestamps (sync-friendly); worksheet offline capture absent.

requirements.text: Concurrent multi-user editing with scribe-holds-the-pen conflict rules.
IEC 61882-conformant report generation (DOCX/PDF/XLSX).
requirements.notes: Structured JSON export only.

requirements.text: Full revision history of every worksheet entry incl. original AI text (immutable audit trail).
requirements.notes: Original suggestion text retained in telemetry events; rejected findings kept as audit records; no full worksheet revision store.

requirements.text: Export action items to common trackers (CSV/REST) and track closure evidence for PSM revalidation.
Study provenance annex: model/prompt/KB versions and aggregate suggestion statistics.
requirements.notes: Version triplet + accept/edit/reject stats captured per event; annex document generator absent.

requirements.text: Revalidation workflows: clone prior study, diff against updated P&IDs (MOC-driven), highlight affected nodes.
Role-based access control mapped to study roles; sign-off restricted to facilitator.
requirements.notes: No auth/roles anywhere yet.

requirements.text: KB curation workflow: review queue, only curator-approved content retrievable, items carry source/date/applicability/confidentiality.
requirements.notes: Curation gates enforced at ingestion (approved-only indexed; pending + gold-holdout excluded); item metadata present; curator review-queue UI absent.

requirements.text: Model governance: versioned models/prompts/retrieval configs; studies pin versions; mid-study upgrades need facilitator acknowledgment.
requirements.notes: Versions carried in telemetry; no pinning enforcement or upgrade-acknowledgment flow.

requirements.text: Foundation LLM (commercial or self-hosted), no fine-tuning on customer data in v1; RAG + prompt engineering.
requirements.notes: Anthropic + OpenAI-compatible local + deterministic stub behind one seam.

requirements.text: Hybrid dense + lexical retrieval with metadata filtering; embedding choice a documented deliverable.
requirements.notes: BM25 + dense with RRF fusion, guideword/parameter filters; hashing-stub embedder default, sentence-transformers optional.

requirements.text: Topology reasoner as deterministic graph algorithms — ML prohibited where exact solutions exist.
Vision/document models: P&ID symbol detection + OCR with training-data plan (incl. synthetic P&IDs).
requirements.notes: Vector drawings handled deterministically without ML (stronger guarantee where applicable); ML/OCR raster path + training-data plan not started.

requirements.text: Critic/verifier models: secondary pass validating schema, topology, evidence grounding before display.
requirements.notes: Two-stage: Stage A tag grounding (deterministic) + Stage B evidence critic (different model than generator).

requirements.text: Curated eval corpus before model development: >= 10 historical HAZOP studies across >= 3 unit types.
requirements.notes: Data-bound: collect public studies (Crawley & Tyler, CSB, CCPS).

requirements.text: Gold-standard test set: >= 20 nodes with expert reference worksheets, held out from retrieval.
requirements.notes: Format + loader + hold-out enforcement done; 1 node authored, 19+ to go.

requirements.text: Data licensing and confidentiality review as gating milestone.
requirements.notes: Provenance-log column planned in corpus manifest.

requirements.text: Cause recall >= 80% in top-10 on gold set.
requirements.notes: Harness + CI gate done; 100% on mock/1-node gold. Real number needs MDL-7 gold set + real generator.

requirements.text: Grounding precision >= 98%: referenced tags must exist in topology (hard gate, blocks release).
requirements.notes: In-pipeline hard gate + independent output-side audit; fabricating-LLM test proves the gate.

requirements.text: Fabrication rate < 1% (citations that do not support the claim), by expert audit of sampled output.
requirements.notes: Automated proxies + deterministic expert audit sheet done; the human audit itself pending.

requirements.text: Latency <= 10 s per deviation at P95 in live-session mode.
requirements.notes: Harness done (nearest-rank P95, injectable clock); real number needs a real-generator run.

requirements.text: Critic detects >= 90% of deliberately seeded worksheet omissions.
requirements.notes: Seeding harness + CI gate; deterministic critic at 100% (60/60), pinned.

requirements.text: Accept/edit/reject telemetry in a schema fit for offline eval / preference tuning; training use needs customer opt-in.
requirements.notes: Versioned JSONL schema + web endpoints + UI buttons, verified end to end.

requirements.text: Canonical data model based on DEXPI / ISO 15926; vendor mapping tables are deliverables.
requirements.notes: L1 exports DEXPI-shaped plant model; L2 consumes it. Vendor mapping tables pending vendor formats.

requirements.text: Risk matrix definitions as customer-configurable data, not code.
requirements.notes: Risk ranking not yet implemented anywhere (FR-ARE-6 keeps it human-only).

requirements.text: Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+); per-customer segregation.
requirements.notes: Dev-server posture only.

requirements.text: Retention >= PSM revalidation cycle + legal hold; deletion needs dual authorization and logging.
Export-control tagging on KB items and studies, with access filtering enforced.
requirements.notes: KB items carry confidentiality classification; access filtering absent (needs FR-AGM-1 auth).

requirements.text: Availability 99.5% hosted; manual mode always available.
requirements.notes: Tied to AR-2 + deployment work.

requirements.text: Scalability: 500+ node studies, 50,000+ worksheet rows without UI degradation.
requirements.notes: Untested at that scale.

requirements.text: Usability: scribe processes accept/edit/reject at live-meeting pace; <= 2 interactions per accepted suggestion.
requirements.notes: One-click accept exists in the dashboard demo; the metric needs the real workspace + a trained scribe.

requirements.text: Security: SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, audit logging, annual pen test.
Portability: on-prem containerized, private cloud, air-gapped variants.
requirements.notes: Dockerized; on-prem LLM path exists; air-gap unvalidated.

requirements.text: Internationalization: English v1; architecture must not preclude additional languages.
requirements.notes: English throughout; nothing language-bound in the data model.

requirements.text: Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA for the study workspace.
Maintainability: prompts, guideword sets, heuristics as versioned configuration, not code.
requirements.notes: Currently Python constants/prompts in code; needs externalizing.

requirements.text: Model performance claims verified by HAZOP-qualified reviewers not involved in development.
requirements.notes: All current numbers are harness-validation on deterministic doubles, flagged as such.

requirements.text: >= 2 shadow-mode pilots with blinded comparison, then >= 1 assisted-mode pilot before GA.
Failure-mode analysis of the tool itself (automation bias, anchoring, coverage illusion) with mitigations.
requirements.notes: Mitigations designed in DDR docs (e.g. tray randomization); the structured assessment not performed.

requirements.text: Release acceptance: all 4.3 hard gates met; zero critical audit-trail defects; regulatory package complete.
requirements.notes: Scorecard automates the 4.3 gate check; rest pending.

requirements.text: Regulatory positioning package: written analysis that team responsibility and PHA obligations are unchanged.
Constraint: tool is advisory; never marketed/configured as replacing the HAZOP team or facilitator judgment.
requirements.notes: Advisory framing enforced in code (human-only rankings, proposals labeled, provenance).

requirements.text: Constraint: not a safety-related system under IEC 61511; no SIS/real-time control functionality.
requirements.notes: No control-system surface exists; claims avoided.

requirements.text: Assumption: customers can provide machine-readable or scannable P&IDs and partial instrument index.
requirements.notes: Held for the 2401 unit (vector P&ID + instrument index extracted).

requirements.text: Assumption: at least one anchor customer provides historical studies for KB seeding under NDA.
requirements.notes: No anchor customer; public-source corpus is the interim plan (MDL-6).

requirements.text: Liability allocation and contract language for AI-assisted safety studies (legal).
requirements.notes: Requires legal counsel; blocks design freeze per the draft.

requirements.text: Whether simulation integration (FR-PML-3) is v1 or v1.1 scope (cost/schedule).
requirements.notes: Current plan: DWSIM adapter next in L2.

requirements.text: Commercial licensing of incident databases for the KB.
On-prem LLM sizing vs quality trade-off for air-gapped customers.
requirements.notes: LocalLLM/LocalEvidenceCritic default to small Ollama models; sizing study not done.
